request.style: English, Christian hip hop, a deep-voiced male rapper with a dramatic cinematic beat, pounding drums, choir pads and strings, a chanted hook by a group, dark to triumphant, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The hand of the Lord came upon me in a vision
Set me down in a valley full of bones, no living
Very many, very dry, sun bleached, forgotten
He said, son of man, can these bones live again
I said, Lord, you know, I can't answer that
He said, prophesy to the bones, tell them this is a fact
Hear the word of the Lord, I will breathe into you
Put flesh on your frame and you will live, it's true

[Chorus]
Dry bones rise, dry bones rise
Hear the word of the Lord tonight
Breath from the four winds, come alive
Dry bones rise

[Verse]
So I prophesied and there was a rattling sound
Bone came to bone all over the ground
Sinews and flesh and the skin on top
But no breath in them yet, so the story didn't stop
Prophesy to the breath, come from the four winds
Breathe on the slain, let them live again
And the breath came in and they stood on their feet
A vast great army, the valley complete

[Chorus]
Dry bones rise, dry bones rise
Hear the word of the Lord tonight
Breath from the four winds, come alive
Dry bones rise
